tiling-services-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: A tile finish depends on the base, material supply and the order of connected work. Use this guide to prepare for an agreed installation scope, then choose your surface from our
tiling-services-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 瓷砖饰面取决于基层、材料供应及相关工序。可用本指南准备约定安装范围，再从以下目录选择区域：

tiling-services-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: We check the existing finish, base, dimensions, access and adjoining surfaces before agreeing the installation. Tile removal may expose loose adhesive, damaged lining or a base that needs further preparation. The scope identifies removal, levelling or screeding and the accessible repair boundary. Hidden findings are discussed before additional work proceeds.
tiling-services-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 确认安装前检查旧饰面、基层、尺寸、通行及相邻表面。拆砖可能暴露松胶、损坏墙衬或需进一步处理的基层。范围列明拆除、找平或砂浆层及可接触维修边界，发现隐蔽状况会在额外施工前讨论。

tiling-services-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: Moisture, movement and unstable material need assessment before they are covered. Where waterproofing is required, preparation and membrane stages are coordinated with the tiling handover. A new tile finish alone does not renew the concealed membrane.
tiling-services-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 潮湿、位移和不稳材料需先评估再覆盖。需要防水时，准备与膜层阶段须协调贴砖交接。新瓷砖饰面不能更新隐蔽防水膜。

tiling-services-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: Confirm whether Ellis or the client supplies the tiles, which format and finish are selected, and when the material will be available. Product dimensions, thickness, edges and intended use affect cuts, transitions and the preparation needed. Share product information before the installation approach is finalised.
tiling-services-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 确认 Ellis 或客户供砖、规格和饰面，以及到货时间。产品尺寸、厚度、边缘和用途影响切割、过渡及准备。最终确定安装方式前请提供产品资料。

tiling-services-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: Set-out brings adjoining surfaces together. We agree visible cuts, corners, trim positions and movement junctions with the selected tile. Check material responsibility, waste handling and protection of retained finishes in the written quote.
tiling-services-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 排布需协调相邻表面，结合所选砖确认可见切割、转角、收口条及伸缩交接。书面报价核对材料责任、清运和保留饰面保护。

tiling-services-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: Removal and base preparation come before the agreed membrane or installation stages. Plumbing, electrical, cabinetry or structural changes need their own confirmed responsibilities and access. Install tiles only when the prepared base and any required membrane are ready for the next stage.
tiling-services-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 拆除及基层准备先于约定膜层或安装阶段。管道、电气、橱柜或结构改动需分别确认责任和通行。基层与所需防水膜达到下一阶段要求后，才能铺砖。

tiling-services-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: Grout and flexible junctions have different roles. Return to use follows the selected materials and site conditions rather than one universal number of hours. Handover explains care, cleaning and any access restrictions. Read the
